title: Photo Search P4-03A UpgradeRun / target-set / budget / pause-resume / profile-activation companion
description: Derived from ADR-0013-upgrade-run-and-profile-activation-contract.md; ADR-0013 is authoritative on any conflict. This companion is a CONTRACT ONLY: P4-03A implements no upgrade behaviour, adds no migration and changes no schema_version. It freezes (a) the upgrade_runs / upgrade_targets row shapes with their closed CHECK vocabularies, (b) the run and target-row finite state machines with their rejected transitions, (c) the plan-time difference-set predicate for upgrade_targets built on the EXISTING index_entries / index_outbox authority columns, (d) the target/seconds/concurrency budget semantics with the batch-boundary soft stop, (e) the six activation gates with their existing error codes and the zero-write obligation, (f) the reference-protection boundary, (g) the failure-classification map onto EXISTING error codes plus a frozen reason vocabulary, (h) the minimal read-only status and control API/UI field set, and (i) the 0017 migration / 16 -> 17 implementability contract. It introduces no new error code and no new top-level error-envelope field, and it declares no supersession of any existing companion.

ContractIdentity.description: ADR-0013 sections 1 and 11: the frozen identity of this contract and of the migration P4-03B must add.

ErrorCode.description: The frozen code set this contract may use. Every one of these already exists in this build's structured error vocabulary (photo_search/catalog/errors.py, or the API-layer codes in photo_search/api/errors.py); ADR-0013 adds none.

RunTransitionMatrix.description: ADR-0013 section 3.1. allowed is exactly the accepted set; every pair of RunState values not listed here is refused with INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION and zero writes. rejected lists the named counterexample classes the ADR fixes.

TargetTransitionMatrix.description: ADR-0013 section 4.4. A target row that was IN_FLIGHT when the process died returns to PLANNED by replay (the in-flight batch stays replayable); a FAILED row may be retried. SUCCEEDED and CANCELLED never reopen.

PauseDetailRule.description: ADR-0013 section 3.3. detail is optional free text that must never carry a local path, a control character or a separator: it is a bounded identifier-like note.

BudgetRule.description: ADR-0013 section 5. Any budget reaching its cap is a soft stop at a batch boundary; the concurrency budget only bounds one claim.

TargetSetPredicate.description: ADR-0013 section 4.1. The one authoritative predicate for 'this asset still needs this profile's (space_id, processor_id, dimension) projection'. It reads the EXISTING index_entries / index_outbox columns; it never invents a second revision space.

ActivationGateRow.$comment: ADR-0013 section 7 (Sol F-D): one gate row is a const, so a legal gate with a legal-but-wrong refusal code or details reason is rejected by the machine contract.

ActivationGateMatrix.description: ADR-0013 section 7. Five evaluable gates plus one atomicity obligation; the sixth item of the card is failure_atomicity, not a predicate.

FailureRow.$comment: ADR-0013 section 9 (Sol F-D): each reason is bound to exactly one frozen row, so a legal reason with a legal-but-wrong code, location, retryable or attempts flag is rejected.

FailureMapping.description: ADR-0013 section 9. Zero new error codes; a secret/CPU downgrade or a silent profile switch is forbidden.

ClockRule.$comment: ADR-0013 section 5.2 (Sol F-C): the only accounting rule, which uniquely fixes pause, resume and restart.

const.effective_elapsed_ms: elapsed_ms + (now - resumed_at if state == RUNNING and clock_owner == this_session else 0)

LeaseRule.$comment: ADR-0013 sections 4.4/4.5 (Sol F-E): one takeover path, one counting point.

AttemptsRule.$comment: ADR-0013 section 4.5 (Sol F-E): attempts counts failures, never replays or retries.

const.increments_exactly_on: the transition into FAILED whose reason counts_toward_attempts is true

ControlIdempotencyRule.$comment: ADR-0013 section 3.2 (Sol F-B): replay is decided before any revision check.

noop_rule.definition: target state already holds AND the request parameters match the state that already holds

BudgetGrantRule.$comment: ADR-0013 sections 5.4/6 (Sol F-C): how a budget-limited run legally continues.

UpgradeControlRequest.description: ADR-0013 section 10.2 (Sol F-B). The closed control-request schema; the HTTP path suffix is the lowercase action.

UpgradeControlRequestRow.description: ADR-0013 section 2.3 (Sol F-B): the durable control-request log that carries request_id idempotency across restarts.

ReferenceProtection.description: ADR-0013 section 8. A generation referenced by any of these kinds may not be RETIRED or cleaned; the refusal reuses INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION with a frozen details.reason.

UpgradeRunProjection.description: ADR-0013 section 10.1: the read-only status projection. Counts and closed state words only; no path, no coordinate, no text.

UpgradeControlResponse.description: ADR-0013 section 10.2. changed is false and control_revision is unchanged when the same control request is replayed on an already-satisfied state.

UpgradeApiError.description: The frozen envelope of every failing endpoint (architecture 10.2). Exactly the three existing top-level keys plus the optional details object: this contract adds no top-level field.

MigrationContract.description: ADR-0013 section 11. P4-03A adds no migration file: it only freezes the implementability contract P4-03B must satisfy.

UpgradeRunRow.description: ADR-0013 section 2.1 as an executable row shape: the closed CHECK vocabularies of upgrade_runs, minus the columns whose rule the JSON cannot express (they are pinned by the contract test against the ADR).

UpgradeTargetRow.description: ADR-0013 section 2.2 as an executable row shape: the closed CHECK vocabularies of upgrade_targets.
